title: Roast mushroom bulgur with rocket pesto

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or simple staple, such as mushrooms, chickpeas, bulgur, walnuts, cheese and lemon, with no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Mushrooms, rocket, bulgur, walnuts and vegetarian hard cheese are all everyday lines at Tesco and similar shops.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, foil, a grater and a knife, and the pesto is chopped by hand rather than in a processor.

works.reason: 200g bulgur to 400ml boiling water, covered in a hot tray for 10 minutes, will cook through, and the mushrooms, chickpeas and pesto give a sensible, well-seasoned dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: Halving mushrooms, cutting onions and chopping the pesto fit in 15 active minutes, and the 30 cook minutes match the 20 plus 10 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: 120g of rocket appears both as the pesto and stirred through, which makes it central rather than a garnish, and a warm traybake suits late April.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain bulgur, chickpeas, mushrooms, nuts and greens make a filling, balanced family dinner.
